forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4NXQSMZF2TE7AP0GW9G6HM8
+- 01M4NXRKC72JZA6WNSS7752WAG
+- 01M4NXZS41BMJKF4Z96556W4RS
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: 'Generate telemetry: a span for each model call with time to first token, tokens per second and cold or warm'
+---
+## What
+
+A model call has no span and no metric. The operator cannot see the time to the first token, the speed of the model, or whether a call had to load the model first.
+
+Files and points:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/PooledModel.swift`: `PooledModel.respond(to:streamingInto:)` (`:91`). It loads the model with `resident.loaded()` (`:95`), then submits the call to the model queue (`loaded.hold.queue.submit`, `:96-98`). `PooledModelExecutor.respond(to:model:streamingInto:)` (`:144`) calls it.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/PooledSession.swift`: `respond(to:)` (`:64`) and `respond(to:generating:)` (`:80`, the guided call) submit the session call to `hold.queue`.
+
+Approach (each name in `ExtrasTelemetry.swift`, metric objects made at call time):
+- Span `FoundationModelsExtras.generate` through `TracedCall`, so that a hung call has an "enter" record. Attributes: `model.ref`, `generate.guided` (`true` for `respond(to:generating:)` at `:80`, else `false`), and `cache.result` (`cold` when the call included a load, else `warm`). Use the `cache.result` key of task `556w4rs`.
+- Open the span before the load and the queue wait, so that it is the parent of the queue wait, the load span (task `8r1175p`, when it exists) and each tool span that opens in the call. Task `7752wag` carries the `ServiceContext` into the detached queue job; this task depends on it.
+- Wrap the `LanguageModelExecutorGenerationChannel` to see the first event and the end:
+  - Timer `generate.time_to_first_token` (from the span start to the first event) and Timer `generate.duration`, both with `model.ref`.
+  - When the channel gives token counts: Counter `generate.output_tokens` and Recorder `generate.tokens_per_second`, both with `model.ref`. When the channel gives no counts, record neither.
+- Never record the prompt, the instructions, the transcript or the output text.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each model call opens one `FoundationModelsExtras.generate` span with `model.ref`, `generate.guided` and `cache.result`, and writes one "enter" log record.
+- [ ] The first call after a load records `cache.result=cold`. A later call records `warm`.
+- [ ] Each call records `generate.time_to_first_token` and `generate.duration`. When the channel gives token counts, the call records `generate.output_tokens` and `generate.tokens_per_second`.
+- [ ] The queue wait span, the load span and each tool span of the call have the generate span as their parent.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/PooledModelTests.swift`: with `StubLanguageModel.swift` and a fake loader, `W3CInMemoryTracer` and `MetricsTestKit` `TestMetrics`, test the span, the attributes, cold and warm, the timers, and a stub that gives token counts and one that gives none.
+- [ ] A parent test: a tool span that opens inside the call has the generate span as its parent.
+- [ ] A content-safety test with `TelemetryCapture.run(forbidding:)` that forbids the prompt and the output text.
+- [ ] One integration test in `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasIntegrationTests/PooledModelIntegrationTests.swift` that runs the real LLM and checks the span, cold then warm, and a time to first token greater than 0.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #feature
\ No newline at end of file
